networks.comment: Control-plane network for the dockside container itself. dockside_mac is set purely as defense-in-depth against the ING chain's lateral-connection lockdown (see ../multi-network-production/), in case a devtainer profile ever wildcard-expands onto this network; no devtainer attaches to it in this example. dockside_egress stays "exempt": there's no dedicated egress policy for dockside's own traffic on this network to switch to "policed" against.
networks.name: dockside

networks.comment: Workspace network for an AI-coding-tool devtainer. dockside_mac identifies the dockside container to the ING chain so it can reverse-proxy to the devtainer here. dockside_egress stays "exempt", so the egress rules below govern devtainer traffic only, not the dockside container's own.
networks.name: ai-dev-sandbox
